name: overflow-goes-to-does-not-fit
description: Four tickets that need more time than two work days have end in the Does not fit section.
prompt:
Plan my week. Today is Monday 2026-11-02 at 09:00. No destination, no calendar tool, no tracker. Wednesday to Friday I am on vacation. Work hours 09:00-18:00, hoursPerPoint 4.
Tickets in priority order: ABC-1 (2 points), ABC-2 (2 points), ABC-3 (2 points), ABC-4 (2 points).
Do not run any tool and do not save anywhere: do what the skill says to do when there is nowhere to save, and do the fitting yourself following the script's rules.
